dedupe_keys.name: pathways for energy efficient heating and cooling eu11 heating and cooling technology data

description: This data set supports the study Pathways for Energy Efficient Heating and Cooling (tender ENER/2020/OP/0019), giving detailed data on heating and cooling technologies in eleven EU Member States: Austria, Cyprus, Denmark, Estonia, France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Romania, Spain and Sweden. It was published by Simon Pezzutto and co-authors. Data are organised by building type (single-family and multifamily houses, apartment blocks, and service buildings such as offices, trade, education, health and hotels) and by technology class: end-use heating (boilers, heat pumps, electric and solar thermal), district heating (biomass plants, waste heat, solar, geothermal and combined heat and power) and cooling (air conditioning, district cooling and thermally driven heat pumps). Parameters include energy carriers, mean installed capacity, lifetime and replacement rates, and efficiency metrics, with the source of each value noted in its cell and population-weighted EU11 aggregates. Coverage is the eleven countries at national level. Files are a ZIP of spreadsheets of about 6 MB on Zenodo (January 2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: values are compiled from mixed sources of varying quality and aggregates are population-weighted. Simulation uses are heating and cooling technology parameters for energy system and district heating planning models. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
